vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.1

The tickerdb skill is a well-documented integration for the TickerDB market intelligence service. It provides structured access to stock, crypto, and ETF data through a variety of endpoints and slash commands. The skill includes a transparent authentication flow in SKILL.md that guides the user through account setup and API key persistence using standard OpenClaw configuration commands. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection was found; all requested permissions and network activities are directly aligned with the stated purpose of providing financial data and automated market reports.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions align with its stated purpose (calling api.tickerdb.com with a TICKERDB_KEY); nothing requested or described appears disproportionate or unrelated.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (market intelligence via TickerDB) match the declared requirement of a single API credential (TICKERDB_KEY) and the documented REST endpoints. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or system paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only on authenticating via email/code, storing the returned apiKey with user consent, querying summary endpoints per ticker, and onboarding watchlists/daily reports — all consistent with a data-provider integration. It does collect the user's email and a one-time verification code for API provisioning, which is necessary for the described auth flow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — lowest-risk footprint. All network calls are to the tickerdb API domain as expected.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only TICKERDB_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential. No other secrets or unrelated environment variables are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no claims to modify other skills or system settings. The skill asks the user before saving the API key; persisting a service API key is proportionate for this integration. Note: agent autonomous invocation is enabled (default) but that is normal for skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its description: it needs only your TICKERDB API key and uses the TickerDB API for data. Before installing, be aware that the skill will ask for your email and a verification code to provision an apiKey; it will prompt you before saving that key. Only grant the TICKERDB_KEY if you trust tickerdb.com, and avoid providing unrelated credentials. If you plan to let the agent run autonomously, understand it can call the TickerDB API (e.g., daily reports or watchlist checks) whenever invoked.
